top_choice_rationale: P001 credits one mechanism, small-molecule-induced E3 ligase proximity, in both its designed form (Crews and Deshaies, PROTACs) and its discovered form (Handa, cereblon as the target of thalidomide-type glues). It rests on ternary-complex structures and degradation kinetics reproduced independently across many targets, and Handa's step turned a decades-old clinical puzzle into a defined chemical mechanism. P002 is the same field with Ciulli in place of Handa; it is sound but omits the cereblon strand. P003 is mature and chemically real but has a narrower design principle and a Medicine 2023 overlap. No award is last because the science in P001 to P003 is sound.
